entries.category_description: Foodstuffs (including beverages but excluding alcoholic beverages) for human and animal consumption; live animals, seeds, plants and ingredients normally intended for use in the preparation of foodstuffs; products normally used to supplement foodstuffs or as a substitute for foodstuffs
entries.comment:
Reduced rate applies to all types of bread,
and all types of milk (cow, sheep, goat) placed on the market under the same name in the liquid state, fresh, pasteurized, homogenized, condensed (other than sour milk, yoghurt, kefir, chocolate milk and other milk products), substitute for mother’s milk.

Foodstuffs (including beverages but excluding alcoholic beverages) for human and animal consumption; live animals, seeds, plants and ingredients normally intended for use in the preparation of foodstuffs; products normally used to supplement foodstuffs or as a substitute for foodstuffs
entries.comment: All foodstuffs except the selected items taxed at 5 % rate and selected foods with increased sugar and salt content. These are goods primarily intended for human consumption or for the production of goods suitable for human consumption.
